_about: Curated dual-use HS reference list bundled as a STATIC ASSET. Sayari exposes no per-HS-code dual-use flag, so we screen shipment HS codes against this list locally and label hits 'our HS screen'. This is the BIS/E5 Common High Priority List (CHPL) of 6-digit HS codes flagged by the US (BIS), EU, UK, Japan, Canada, Australia, and New Zealand as critical to Russian weapons systems. It is intentionally structured so a second list (e.g. EU dual-use Annex I) can be appended later with its own `list` id without touching the screen logic. Reconcile against the official published CHPL before any production use.
